race.comment: Open one to finish. COVERT THINKING (4) put in a much better run last start stepping up to 1900m at Canterbury, running on well in a BM72 to grab second. She's a consistent sort of mare who looks well placed this level. Stablemate OMNIC (3) will be one of the hardest to beat. He won two on the bounce then just found one better here last time in a similar race. He'll be up on speed and hard to run down. DENY ENTRY (8) is another lightly raced type who stuck on well behind an all the way winner with strong 3yo form at Sandown lakeside. Fitter again and has strong claims. QUEENSBURY (7) is consistent with four minor placings in a row, he maps well and should be right there again.
